[exit 0]

$ bronzewardctl --context human fragment set worker-labels --draft {draft} --layer role --file worker-labels.yaml

$ bronzewardctl --context human profile set workers --draft {draft} --fragments worker-labels

[exit 0]

$ bronzewardctl --context human assignment set {machine} --draft {draft} --profiles workers

[exit 0]
